free_tier.stated: KRW 300,000 of credit to a new account that registers a payment method and is approved: '가입만 하시면, 30만 크레딧을 바로 드립니다'. The credit is one per account, valid three months, and usable on every product. GPU Server and Bare Metal Server need prior arrangement through a console enquiry before use.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: KRW 300,000 at Korean list prices buys roughly 15 months of a 1 vCPU box or 60 hours of a 16 vCPU box, and it is the largest Korean credit found that is not tied to a school.

limits.value: The credit arrives only after an account application and a payment-method registration are approved by the vendor, so the gate is a manual approval rather than a signup form; the credit also expires in three months, which is what limits how much of it can be spent on a slow-building workload.

identity_cost.detail: a payment method plus a vendor approval: the credit is granted on registering a payment method (the account application step), after signup and console login, followed by an approval mail and then the credit, so the gate is a manual approval on top of the payment method rather than a signup form. No authorisation or hold amount is stated, and whether the payment method may be a debit or prepaid card is not stated: unknown. GPU Server and Bare Metal Server need a 1:1 console enquiry first.

evidence.proved: the page states that a new signup receives 300,000 credits on registering a payment method, that the sequence is 회원가입, console login, 어카운트 신청 (payment method registration), approval mail, credit receipt, and that the credit is one per account, valid three months; it also states that GPU Server and Bare Metal Server need a 1:1 console enquiry first
